options.B: Because the currency of evidence is vital in clinical sciences
options.C: To hide the names of authors
options.D: Because publishers demand it for copyright

explanation: APA emphasizes the date because healthcare practices rely heavily on current, up-to-date scientific evidence and updated treatment protocols. [learn more](GNS217_U3_T7#GNS217_U3_T7_h4)

question: Which structure directly covers the opposing bone surfaces inside a synovial joint to prevent friction?

options.A: Fibrous capsule
options.B: Synovial membrane
options.C: Articular cartilage
options.D: Intrinsic ligament

explanation: Articular cartilage consists of hyaline cartilage covering bone ends, acting as a smooth cushion to minimize friction. [learn more](GNS121_U3_T5#GNS121_U3_T5_h4)

question: What critical instruction must a nurse give to a patient taking a liquid suspension at home?

options.A: Always use a household tablespoon for easy dosing.
options.B: Vigorously shake the bottle before measuring every single dose.
options.C: Store the medication in direct sunlight on the windowsill.
options.D: Stop taking the drug as soon as you feel better.

explanation: Patients must be taught to shake the bottle every time to ensure the active drug particles are evenly distributed. [learn more](GNS122_U1_T21#GNS122_U1_T21_h7)

question: Why is daily temperature monitoring of ward refrigerators legally and clinically necessary for medication storage?

options.A: To ensure energy conservation
options.B: To maintain drug potency and prevent chemical degradation
options.C: To keep the nursing station comfortable
options.D: To comply with fire safety codes

explanation: Precise temperature monitoring ensures that temperature-sensitive drugs maintain their potency and do not degrade or become toxic. [learn more](GNS125_U2_T13#GNS125_U2_T13_h3)
